verdict.rationale: stagewise's agent has shell access to run commands, which implies it could run git. Its GitHub plugin lists repository access and pull requests, so opening PRs is plausible. No first-party docs describe a git workflow covering staging, commit message generation, or branch creation, so the story is only implied through generic shell access plus a plugin. Missing for 10: documented git staging and commit-message generation, explicit branch creation support, a documented PR-opening workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
